```{r}
#| label: tbl-rd02-selected-species-estimates
#| echo: false
#| tbl-cap: >
#|   Regeneration basal area 10 years after harvest for all four species
#|   categories. Entries are arithmetic mean (lower, upper 95% confidence
#|   limits), in m^2^ ha^-1^. Each category was modeled separately using
#|   zero-inflated Gamma responses, treatment as a fixed effect, and site and
#|   macro-plot-within-site random intercepts. Means include modeled zeros and
#|   integrate over both random-effect distributions. Intervals use the
#|   full-parameter log-scale delta method and describe uncertainty in means.
#|   Each model uses 64 vegetation plots across four sites and 16 macro plots.
#|   GS = group selection; LD = low-density dispersed retention; HA =
#|   high-density aggregated retention; HD = high-density dispersed retention.

rd02_selected_values <- read.csv(
  "outputs/regeneration/selected-species-models/tables/rd02-selected-species-estimates.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
stopifnot(nrow(rd02_selected_values) == 16L,
          !anyDuplicated(rd02_selected_values[c("spp", "treat")]),
          all(is.finite(as.matrix(rd02_selected_values[c("estimate", "lcl", "ucl")]))))
rd02_category_labels <- c(rw = "Redwood", to = "Tanoak", df = "Douglas-fir", other = "Other species")
rd02_selected_table <- data.frame(Species = unname(rd02_category_labels))
for (trt in c("gs", "ld", "ha", "hd")) {
  values <- rd02_selected_values[rd02_selected_values$treat == trt, ]
  values <- values[match(names(rd02_category_labels), values$spp), ]
  stopifnot(!anyNA(values$estimate))
  rd02_selected_table[[toupper(trt)]] <- sprintf(
    "%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", values$estimate, values$lcl, values$ucl
  )
}
knitr::kable(rd02_selected_table, row.names = FALSE, align = c("l", rep("r", 4)))
```
